item.title: Random: Sonic Figure Containing The Blue Blur's "DNA" Comes With An Eye-Watering Price Tag

description.p: That's a lot of Rings.Earlier this year, SEGA revealed a life-size Sonic statue that contained the hedgehog's "DNA" (yes, really), housed in the Shibuya SEGA store. In the months since, a trip to Tokyo has been the only way you could get a look at the weird creation, but you'll soon be able to have one in your home... if you can stomach the insane price tag.As brought to our attention by Dexerto, the "DNA"-filled statue will soon be available as a smaller figurine for an eye-watering ¥3,300,000 (which is around $20,000 or £16,000, for those wondering). It's now available to pre-order from the Kadokawa store and is expected to ship (oh yes, the above cost doesn't include shipping) in January 2027 — not that it matters, because who is buying this??Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Nintendo States That It Has No Plans To Ditch Physical Media

description.p: "We know how much the fans like it".Bill van Zyll, vice president and general manager of Nintendo Latin America, has stated that the company currently has "no plans to ditch physical" media.This comes via an interview with Coelho no Japão on YouTube (thanks Nintendo Everything) at a time in which physical media is more at risk than ever. With Sony confirming its plan to cease production of PlayStation discs in early 2028 and Microsoft likely to follow suit, questions have no undoubtedly lingered as to whether Nintendo will also go all-digital. Thankfully, that doesn't seem to be the case... at least for now.Read the full article on nintendolife.com
